Trump says Iran has a 'dream' for war to continue after US midterm elections
item.description:
Trump says Iran has a 'dream' for war to continue after US midterm elections

US President Donald Trump claimed that Iran has a "dream" for the war to remain ongoing beyond the November midterm elections.

"Well, it’ll end very fast. As soon as the war ends – and it will end one way or the other very quickly – oil is going to drop like a rock," Trump said during a campaign rally in North Carolina

He added that the rise of energy prices were a "very small price to pay for keeping a nuclear weapon away from the world’s number one state sponsor of terror".

Smotrich says Israel should ‘annex’ territory it occupies in Gaza and Lebanon

Speaking on a podcast, far-right finance minister Bezalel Smotrich said Israel should annex territory it currently occupies in Gaza and Lebanon in order to "make them truly feel the cost of their mistake and the cost of their defeat".

"We need to annex at least up to the lines we’re currently holding. And if Hezbollah attacks again, then all the way to Beirut. And if they attack, then even beyond that," he said.

Lebanon dismisses Israel allegations that it failed to curb Hezbollah activity
item.description:
Lebanon dismisses Israel allegations that it failed to curb Hezbollah activity

The Lebanese army on Tuesday accused Israel of spreading misinformation, after Tel Aviv claimed Beirut failed to disarm Hezbollah south of the Litani River as stipulated under a ceasefire agreement.

"On October 20, 2026, the Israeli occupation, through its official page on the X platform, issued baseless claims regarding the operations of the Lebanese Army in the south of the Litani region, casting doubt on its ability to carry out the tasks assigned to it," a post from the official X account for the Lebanese army read.

The army went on to reaffirm its commitment to existing agreements, while accusing Israel of continued attacks and violations on the country.

Earlier, Israeli military spokesperson Ella Waweya accused Lebanon's military of failing to put a stop to Hezbollah activity south of the Litani River.

According to The New Arab, the Israeli allegations come just hours before US-mediated talks between Lebanon and Israel.

بتاريخ ٢٠ / ١٠ / ٢٠٢٦، أطلق الاحتلال الإسرائيلي عبر صفحته الرسمية على منصة إكس ادعاءات باطلة بشأن عمل الجيش اللبناني في منطقة جنوب الليطاني، مشكّكًا في قدرته على تنفيذ المهام الموكلة إليه. في هذا السياق، توضح قيادة الجيش أنّ الوحدات العسكرية باشرت في كانون الأول ٢٠٢٥ معالجة منشأة عسكرية في بلدة كفرا – بنت جبيل، واستمرّت في تنفيذ مهمتها حتى تاريخ ١٦ / ٣ / ٢٠٢٦، حين أوقفت العمل داخل المنشأة وأخلت المنطقة بناءً على طلب لجنة الإشراف على وقف الأعمال العدائية (Mechanism) نتيجة التهديدات الإسرائيلية بقصفها، مع الإشارة إلى أنّ قيادة الجيش أبلغتها أنّ المهمة لم تُستكمَل بعد، وأنّ كمية من الأعتدة العسكرية والذخائر الحربية لا تزال موجودة داخل المنشأة، التي تعرّضت لاحقًا لقصف إسرائيلي. على الرغم من مطالبة الجيش مرارًا بتأمين استئناف العمل لاستكمال تفريغ المنشأة، اصطدمت هذه المساعي بالرفض الإسرائيلي، إلى أنْ استأنفت الوحدات العسكرية مهمتها بتاريخ ١٥ / ٨ / ٢٠٢٦، بالتنسيق مع Mechanism، وواصلت العمل حتى إنجازه بصورة نهائية وإقفال المنشأة بتاريخ ١٦ / ١٠ / ٢٠٢٦. أمّا مقطع الفيديو الذي تظهر فيه شاحنة تعرّضت لاستهداف إسرائيلي، يعود لتاريخ ٣ / ٧ / ٢٠٢٦ وفي منطقة صديقين – صور، أي بعد حوالي أسبوع من توقيع اتفاق الإطار. تؤكّد قيادة الجيش أنّ جميع هذه الوقائع والإجراءات موثّقة لدى لجنة الإشراف على وقف الأعمال العدائية، بما يدحض الادعاءات الإسرائيلية ويُثبت حقيقة الجهود التي تبذلها المؤسسة العسكرية في الجنوب. كما تشدّد على أنّ تكرار حملات التضليل ونشر الأكاذيب في الآونة الأخيرة من قبل الاحتلال الإسرائيلي يندرج في سياق محاولات النيل من مصداقية الجيش محليًّا ودوليًّا، بالتزامن مع المفاوضات الجارية. تجدّد قيادة الجيش تأكيد التزامها الكامل أداء واجباتها وتعهداتها وتنفيذ المهام الموكلة إليها، في حين يواصل الاحتلال الإسرائيلي اعتداءاته وخروقاته للتفاهمات القائمة. #الجيش_اللبناني #LebaneseArmy https://t.co/br4oNcJgrI

Iran’s president says US must lift sanctions, end threats before negotiations
item.description: Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian said Tuesday that the US must end pressure and threats and lift sanctions before any negotiations, Anadolu reports. “All regional problems, from escalating tensions to disruptions in the Strait of Hormuz, stem from US warmongering,” Pezeshkian said during a meeting in Tehran with Pakistan’s army chief, Field Marshal Asim Munir, according to remarks carried by Iranian state broadcaster IRIB. “The Americans must explain why they started the war and embroiled themselves and the world in it,” he said. On the prospect of talks, Pezeshkian said: “Before any negotiations, they must first end the pressure and threats and lift sanctions.” Munir arrived in Tehran on Tuesday, accompanied by a delegation of officials. item.title: Iran says supertanker carrying over 2 million barrels of oil hit mine near Hormuz
item.description: A supertanker carrying more than 2 million barrels of crude oil exploded and caught fire after striking a naval mine south of the Strait of Hormuz, the Navy of Iran’s Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) said Tuesday, Anadolu reports. In a statement carried by state broadcaster IRIB, the navy said the vessel was committing violations and that it had switched off all its radar and navigation systems. OPINION: Trump can strike Iran again. He cannot bomb Hormuz open The tanker ignored warnings from the IRGC Navy and was trying to leave the strait through an “unauthorized southern route” when it struck the mine, according to the statement. item.title: Israeli attacks kill 6 Palestinians, including 2 children, in Gaza despite ceasefire
item.description: Six Palestinians, including two children and a married couple, were killed and eleven injured in Israeli attacks in the Gaza Strip on Tuesday, in the latest violations of an effective ceasefire. A Palestinian was killed and another injured in an Israeli strike near al-Sawarha cemetery, west of the Nuseirat refugee camp in central Gaza, medical sources told Anadolu Agency. One Palestinian was seriously injured in an Israeli drone strike on the al-Qasasib area of the Jabalia refugee camp in the north, according to medical sources. Another Palestinian was killed in an Israeli strike in the Zeitoun neighborhood southeast of Gaza City, medical sources told Anadolu. A Palestinian child was also killed by Israeli army fire in the Wadi Gaza area […]

item.title: Israel’s Ben-Gvir boasts of Gaza’s destruction, mocks Palestinian residents in AI-generated video
item.description: Israeli far-right National Security Minister Itamar Ben-Gvir boasted Tuesday of the destruction of the Gaza Strip and mocked Palestinian residents in a campaign video released ahead of parliamentary elections, Anadolu reports. Ben-Gvir, leader of the far-right Jewish Power party, posted the AI-generated clip on US social media platform X, presenting a vision of Gaza in 2030 based on the widespread destruction inflicted by his government. The video shows the enclave as a ghost town, with its schools, infrastructure and port destroyed. A scene showing a donkey is followed by the party’s message: “You’d have to be a donkey to stay in Gaza,” mocking Palestinians who remain. Ben-Gvir has repeatedly demanded occupying Gaza, displacing its Palestinian population and establishing Israeli settlements […]
